articles.title: How to Set a Realistic Wedding Budget
articles.content: Start by determining how much you can comfortably spend without going into debt. Consider contributions from family, your own savings, and any financing options. A good rule of thumb is to never spend more than you can pay off within a year after the wedding. Prioritize what matters most to you and your partner — whether that's the venue, food, or photography — and allocate more of your budget there. Remember to include a 5-10% buffer for unexpected expenses.

articles.title: Typical Wedding Budget Breakdown
articles.content: While every wedding is unique, industry data suggests common allocations: venue (25-35%), catering (20-25%), photography/videography (8-12%), music and entertainment (6-10%), flowers and decoration (5-8%), attire (5-8%), invitations (2-4%), transport (2-4%), honeymoon (5-10%), and miscellaneous (3-5%). These percentages serve as starting points — adjust based on your priorities. Couples who prioritize food might allocate 30% to catering, while those who love photography might spend 15% on a premium photographer.

articles.title: Money-Saving Tips for Your Wedding
articles.content: Choose an off-peak date (weekday or winter) for significant venue discounts. Limit your guest list — each additional guest increases catering, invitation, and favor costs. Consider a brunch or lunch reception instead of dinner. DIY elements like centerpieces and favors can save hundreds. Book vendors early for better rates, and don't be afraid to negotiate. Use seasonal, locally-sourced flowers to reduce floral costs. Finally, set clear priorities with your partner so you invest in what truly matters to you.

items.question: How does the wedding budget calculator work?
items.answer: Enter your total budget and number of guests, then customize the percentage allocation for each wedding category (venue, catering, photography, etc.). The calculator instantly shows the dollar amount per category, total allocated vs. remaining budget, cost per guest, and a visual chart of your budget distribution.

items.question: What is a typical wedding budget breakdown?
items.answer: A common breakdown allocates 30% to venue, 20% to catering, 10% to photography, 8% to music, 7% each to flowers, attire, and honeymoon, 3% each to invitations and transport, and 5% to miscellaneous. These are starting points — adjust based on your priorities.

items.question: Can I change the budget amounts instead of percentages?
items.answer: Yes. You can edit either the percentage or the amount for any category. When you change an amount, the percentage updates automatically, and vice versa. This gives you full flexibility in planning.

items.question: What happens if my percentages don't add up to 100%?
items.answer: The calculator shows a warning when percentages don't sum to 100%. You can use the auto-normalize feature to proportionally adjust all percentages back to 100%, or manually adjust individual categories.

items.question: How much should I budget per guest?
items.answer: Per-guest costs vary widely by location and style. In the US, the average ranges from $100-$300 per guest. Upscale venues in major cities can exceed $500 per guest. Our calculator shows your per-guest cost in real time so you can evaluate trade-offs between guest count and overall spending.

items.question: Is the wedding budget calculator free?
items.answer: Yes, the wedding budget calculator is completely free with no registration required. Use it as many times as you need while planning your wedding.

items.question: Can I use different currencies?
items.answer: Yes. You can select your preferred currency symbol ($, €, £, lei) for display formatting. The calculations work the same regardless of currency.

items.question: What categories are included?
items.answer: The calculator includes 10 standard wedding categories: Venue, Catering, Photography, Music & Entertainment, Flowers & Decoration, Attire & Accessories, Invitations & Stationery, Transport, Honeymoon, and Miscellaneous. Each has a default percentage that you can customize.

articles.title: Cum Stabilești un Buget Realist pentru Nuntă
articles.content: Începe prin a determina cât poți cheltui confortabil fără a te îndatora. Ia în considerare contribuțiile familiei, economiile proprii și opțiunile de finanțare. O regulă bună este să nu cheltuiești mai mult decât poți achita într-un an după nuntă. Prioritizează ce contează cel mai mult pentru tine și partenerul tău — fie că e locația, mâncarea sau fotografia — și alocă mai mult din buget acolo. Include un buffer de 5-10% pentru cheltuieli neprevăzute.

articles.title: Defalcarea Tipică a Bugetului de Nuntă
articles.content: Deși fiecare nuntă este unică, datele din industrie sugerează alocări comune: locație (25-35%), catering (20-25%), fotografie/videografie (8-12%), muzică și divertisment (6-10%), flori și decorațiuni (5-8%), ținută (5-8%), invitații (2-4%), transport (2-4%), luna de miere (5-10%) și diverse (3-5%). Aceste procente sunt puncte de plecare — ajustează în funcție de prioritățile tale.

articles.title: Sfaturi pentru Economii la Nuntă
articles.content: Alege o dată în afara sezonului (zi de lucru sau iarnă) pentru reduceri semnificative la locație. Limitează lista de invitați — fiecare invitat suplimentar crește costurile. Ia în considerare o recepție la prânz în loc de cină. Elementele DIY pot economisi sute. Rezervă devreme pentru tarife mai bune și nu ezita să negociezi. Folosește flori de sezon pentru a reduce costurile florale.

articles.title: So setzen Sie ein realistisches Hochzeitsbudget
articles.content: Beginnen Sie damit, zu bestimmen, wie viel Sie bequem ausgeben können, ohne Schulden zu machen. Berücksichtigen Sie Beiträge der Familie, eigene Ersparnisse und Finanzierungsmöglichkeiten. Eine gute Faustregel: Geben Sie nie mehr aus, als Sie innerhalb eines Jahres nach der Hochzeit abbezahlen können. Priorisieren Sie, was Ihnen und Ihrem Partner am wichtigsten ist — ob Location, Essen oder Fotografie. Planen Sie einen Puffer von 5-10% für unerwartete Ausgaben ein.

articles.title: Typische Hochzeitsbudget-Aufteilung
articles.content: Branchendaten zeigen gängige Aufteilungen: Location (25-35%), Catering (20-25%), Fotografie/Video (8-12%), Musik und Unterhaltung (6-10%), Blumen und Dekoration (5-8%), Kleidung (5-8%), Einladungen (2-4%), Transport (2-4%), Flitterwochen (5-10%) und Sonstiges (3-5%). Diese Prozentsätze sind Ausgangspunkte — passen Sie sie nach Ihren Prioritäten an.

articles.title: Spartipps für Ihre Hochzeit
articles.content: Wählen Sie ein Datum außerhalb der Hochsaison für deutliche Rabatte. Begrenzen Sie die Gästeliste — jeder zusätzliche Gast erhöht die Kosten. Erwägen Sie einen Brunch statt Abendessen. DIY-Elemente können Hunderte sparen. Buchen Sie frühzeitig für bessere Preise und scheuen Sie sich nicht zu verhandeln. Verwenden Sie saisonale, lokale Blumen.

articles.title: Cómo establecer un presupuesto de boda realista
articles.content: Comienza determinando cuánto puedes gastar cómodamente sin endeudarte. Considera las contribuciones familiares, tus ahorros y opciones de financiamiento. Nunca gastes más de lo que puedes pagar en un año después de la boda. Prioriza lo que más importa para ti y tu pareja. Incluye un colchón del 5-10% para gastos imprevistos.

articles.title: Desglose típico del presupuesto de boda
articles.content: Los datos del sector sugieren: local (25-35%), catering (20-25%), fotografía/video (8-12%), música y entretenimiento (6-10%), flores y decoración (5-8%), vestimenta (5-8%), invitaciones (2-4%), transporte (2-4%), luna de miel (5-10%) y varios (3-5%). Estos porcentajes son puntos de partida — ajusta según tus prioridades.

articles.title: Consejos para ahorrar en tu boda
articles.content: Elige una fecha fuera de temporada para descuentos significativos. Limita la lista de invitados. Considera un brunch o almuerzo en lugar de cena. Los elementos DIY pueden ahorrar cientos de euros. Reserva temprano para mejores tarifas y no dudes en negociar. Usa flores de temporada y locales.

items.question: ¿Cómo funciona la calculadora de presupuesto boda?
items.answer: Ingresa tu presupuesto total y número de invitados, luego personaliza el porcentaje para cada categoría. La calculadora muestra instantáneamente el monto por categoría, presupuesto asignado vs restante, costo por invitado y un gráfico de distribución.

items.question: ¿Cuál es el desglose típico del presupuesto de boda?
items.answer: Un desglose común: 30% local, 20% catering, 10% fotografía, 8% música, 7% cada uno para flores, vestimenta y luna de miel, 3% cada uno para invitaciones y transporte, 5% varios.

items.question: ¿Puedo modificar los montos en lugar de los porcentajes?
items.answer: Sí. Puedes editar el porcentaje o el monto para cualquier categoría. La calculadora sincroniza automáticamente el otro valor.

items.question: ¿La calculadora es gratuita?
items.answer: Sí, la calculadora es completamente gratuita y sin registro necesario.

items.question: ¿Puedo usar diferentes monedas?
items.answer: Sí. Selecciona tu símbolo de moneda preferido ($, €, £, lei) para el formato de visualización.
